summary: Tested new 'Lavori dal cantiere' feature (dipendenti + PWA + queue). Backend: 19/19 pytest passed covering dipendenti CRUD (create/list/rigenera-chiave/toggle/delete/empty-name-400), mobile API auth (missing/wrong/disattivato -> 401, me/clienti-dedup/articoli 200), POST /api/mobile/lavori with client_uid dedupe, admin pending queue (list/count/approva flow with cliente lookup, ore+dipendente set on Lavoro, cost override, approve-twice -> 404, invalid cliente -> 400, rifiuta, import-qr dedup + origine 'qr'), Lavori regression with new ore+dipendente fields, backup includes dipendenti + lavori_pending. Frontend: admin /dipendenti 'Dipendenti e chiavi' tab OK (add+chiave-dialog with QR+text, rigenera with custom ConfirmDialog (NOT window.confirm), toggle, delete). PWA /app-dipendente OK after fix (wrong key toast, real login, download clienti, search+select cliente, ore+descrizione, salva to local queue, coda-badge=1, sync => 'Inviato' shown, QR dialog opens, logout). Admin 'Da approvare' tab: pending rows visible, approva-dialog opens with prefilled fields, costo override + approve => row disappears from list. QR manual import path works: pastes JSON, progress '1/1', importa success. Found 2 real bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime TypeError after successful approve: 'Cannot read properties of null (reading cliente_trovato)'. Cause: dialog body renders while item becomes null on onClose() but form state 'f' is still truthy — the condition {!item.cliente_trovato && ...} crashes. Fix: change to {item && !item.cliente_trovato && ...} OR guard the outer render with (item && f) instead of just (f).

Loading /app-dipendente when not admin-authenticated triggers 401 on global YearProvider's api.get('/anni') which via api.js interceptor redirects to /login?redirect=/app-dipendente. Effectively the PWA can NEVER be used by employees on a fresh device.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix public /app-dipendente redirect-loop. Options: (a) exclude YearProvider/AuthProvider from mounting on /app-dipendente route (wrap providers around Layout only), OR (b) extend the axios 401 interceptor's path allow-list to include '/app-dipendente' (I applied this workaround so the flow could be tested — see src/lib/api.js). Ideally split providers so the public PWA doesn't call any admin-cookie endpoints.
HIGH: Guard ApprovaDialog.jsx against item=null during close animation. Wrap the inner body with (item && f) or use item?.cliente_trovato.
Consider adding data-testid on ConfirmDialog's confirm button (e.g., confirm-dialog-ok) for easier automated testing — currently only findable via text 'Conferma'.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/api.js interceptor: hard-codes public routes; a cleaner fix is to only redirect on 401 for calls made from ProtectedRoute pages. Current approach is fragile.
AppDipendente is wrapped in AuthProvider+YearProvider (global). YearProvider hits /api/anni on mount for every route including the public PWA — leaks admin data model into public flows.
routers/dipendenti.py inserisci_pending: uses datetime.now() (no tz) for 'data'; consistent with lavori router but inconsistent with created_at (timezone.utc). Acceptable, but be aware.
routers/dipendenti.py approva_pending merges override with model_dump() including None for un-set fields is fine because handler filters {k:v for k,v if v is not None}; consider centralizing.
routers/mobile.py get_dipendente updates 'ultimo_accesso' on every request — could be throttled to avoid write amplification.
mobileStore.login() writes key to localStorage BEFORE the /me call verifies it — on failure logout() clears it. Ok but a stale invalid key persists briefly if the app crashes mid-call.
ApprovaDialog references item.articoli_magazzino inside the {f && ...} block without an item?. guard, so same null-crash risk when closing after approve of pending with articoli.

/app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (temporary workaround: added /app-dipendente and /recupero-pin to interceptor allow-list — main agent should review/replace with proper provider scoping)

Auth uses Bearer token from POST /api/auth/login {password:'admin'}. The critical route bug for /app-dipendente was worked around in src/lib/api.js — the real fix (isolate providers or refactor interceptor) is still pending. ApprovaDialog crash after approve reproduces at /dipendenti > Da approvare > btn-approva-* > btn-approva-conferma.
rca of the issue: 1) /app-dipendente 401-redirect: YearProvider (global) calls api.get('/anni') on mount; the shared axios interceptor at src/lib/api.js redirects any non-/auth/ 401 to /login. So an unauthenticated visit to the public PWA gets redirected. Reproduce: open incognito -> /app-dipendente -> redirected to /login. Mitigation applied: added '/app-dipendente' to the interceptor allow-list. Proper fix: move AuthProvider+YearProvider inside the ProtectedRoute (Layout) wrapper, keeping /app-dipendente strictly public. 2) ApprovaDialog crash: on successful approve, onDone() reloads list, onClose() sets parent's approving=null; the Dialog remains open during the closing animation, and its body still evaluates {!item.cliente_trovato && ...} where item is now null. Fix: {item && !item.cliente_trovato && ...} or guard outer render with (item && f).
